caption: The drawing consists of a central rectangular scene bordered by an elaborate, ornamental gray and white frame with scrolling foliage, floral elements, and symmetrical patterns extending below the frame in a decorative design. Inside the rectangular scene, there is a landscape with a light blue sky transitioning to a pink hue near the horizon, a large sailing ship with white sails and red accents on the water to the left, a path or road leading from the foreground toward the ship, and several green trees and bushes throughout. On the path, there is a brown ox or cow pulling a cart, accompanied by two human figures; one is standing and wearing a blue garment, and the other appears to be operating or walking with the animal. To the right of the scene is a brown, two-story house with a gabled roof, white window frames, and a picket fence, set among green vegetation. The surrounding decorative designs and frame are done in shades of gray and appear embossed or raised compared to the plain, off-white background of the entire sheet. The artist's signature is visible in the lower left corner, and there is a small, horizontal measurement scale at the bottom right.
title: Wall Paper
